/**

 * decision it requires once. Instances are not needed: all methods are static and thread-safe.
 */
public final class RiskCategory {

    public static final String DECISION = "Risk Category";

    private RiskCategory() {
    }

    /**
     * @return the decision's value, a {@code string}; null for FEEL's null, as when no rule matches and the table has no default output
     * @throws io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.exceptions.HitPolicyViolationException if a decision table's hit policy is violated

     */

        var inputData = new java.util.HashMap<String, Object>();
        inputData.put("Applicant Age", input.applicantAge());
        return (String) CreditModel.graph().evaluate(DECISION, inputData);
    }

    /** Findings of the static analysis of the decision's table (overlaps, unreachable rules, gaps); empty for other logic. */
